Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL3070 (Intercellular adhesion molecule 1). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3070, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation =, and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
